paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: Comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates. Due to the significant difference in values between high and low sparsity rates, we use the logarithmic results for comparison.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма сравнява Per-Output и Per-Layer perplexity при различни sparsity rates. Хоризонталната ос представя sparsity rate, който варира от 10% до 80%, означени с последователни проценти, подредени от низходящ ред. Вертикалната ос показва perplexity, изразена в логаритмична скала, започваща от 1 и достигаща до 2, с равномерни интервали от 10. Отделните стълбове представляват perplexity на стойностите на output и layer. Стълбът с син цвят показва Per-Output perplexity, който показва стойности около 60%, 40%, 30%, 20% и 10%. Стълбът с оранжев цвят показва Per-Layer perplexity, който показва стойности около 80%, 60%, 40%, 10% и 5%.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表比较了在不同斯帕西蒂率下，每输出和每层似然率。水平轴标注了斯帕西蒂率，从 10% 到 80%，以 10% 的均匀间隔显示。垂直轴标注了“Perplexity 稀疏率”，使用对数刻度，范围从 1e-1 到 8e2，单位为百分比。图表显示了两个柱状图组：蓝色柱状图代表 “Per-Output” 似然率，橙色柱状图代表 “Per-Layer” 似然率。蓝色柱状图高于橙色柱状图，其高度分别是 60% 和 80%，青色柱状图看起来比橙色柱状图要高，并注意其数值包含 40%, 50% 和 70%。橙色柱状图的数值是 10%, 30% 和 60%。两个柱状图的长度大致相同，因此，该图表明确地展示了在不同斯帕西蒂率下，每输出和每层似然率之间的表示。图表没有按特定方式排序，但蓝色柱状图做出了强调，以与橙色柱状图区分开来。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of perplexity rates for a model at different sparsity rates. The horizontal axis, labeled “Sparsity Rate,” displays a linear progression from 10% to 80%, with tick labels indicating intervals of 10%. The vertical axis, labeled “Perplexity,” uses a logarithmic scale and ranges from approximately 1 to 10,000, with tick labels spaced by logarithmic increments. There are two bars, one colored blue and representing “Per-Output” perplexity, and another colored orange representing “Per-Layer” perplexity. The blue bar reaches a value of approximately 8,000 at 70% sparsity, while the orange bar reaches a value of approximately 10 at 50% sparsity.  The blue bar is consistently taller than the orange bar across the entire range of sparsity rates, and the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Per-Output-Perplexität und die Per-Layer-Perplexität für verschiedene Sparsity-Raten. Die Y-Achse stellt die Perplexität dar, die von 1 bis 10 ansteigt und in logarithmischen Schritten dargestellt ist. Die X-Achse stellt die Sparsity-Rate dar, die in 10%-, 20%-, 30%-, 40%-, 50%-, 60%-, 70%-, 80% Bedeutungen enthält. Es gibt zwei Balkengruppen, wobei die blaue Gruppe die Per-Output-Perplexität und die orange Gruppe die Per-Layer-Perplexität darstellt. Der längste blaue Balken entspricht etwa 9,5, während der kürzeste Blaue-Balken etwa 6,5 entspricht. Der längste orange Balken entspricht etwa 7,5, während der kürzeste orange Balken etwa 5,5 entspricht.  Alle Balken sind vertikal ausgerichtet und die Balkenstehle sind in Blau bzw. Orange eingefärbt.
